notes.title: V1.0.2 - Fixed returns being tripled instead of doubled
notes.content:
If you went all in with 100 points, you'd end up with 300 points. You're meant to only have 200. 

[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]
FIXED - Points are tripled not doubled

notes.title: V1.0.1 - Added questionnaire and changed beekeeper criteria
notes.content:
There's now an option to take a survey about the game from the pause menu, if you're feeling generous! 

I've also changed the "Beekeeper" achievement. You no longer need to complete the minigame if you don't want to, you just have to open it. The purpose of making it an achievement is to make sure that no one misses it, not to force you to play. 

[h3]CHANGELOG[/h3]
ADDED - Survey button on pause menu
CHANGED - Beekeeper achievement no longer requires you to complete the bee minigame, just open it.
